data.body: Consideration: [Conflicting assumptions] Tag inheritance via story→epic chain — define behavior when the epic's strata:scoped tag is unset mid-flight (after brainstorm rescrutiny). Required: snapshot the tag value at implementation-plan ENTRY (not on every task emit) so two concurrent S6 runs against the same epic produce deterministic output. Document the snapshot point in the skill body and assert it in S1 RED tests.
